title: RURAL DEVELOPMENT SCHEMES
text:
Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau

Ministry of Rural Development

RURAL DEVELOPMENT SCHEMES

प्रविष्टि तिथि:
21 JUL 2026 7:00PM by PIB Delhi

Under Budget Estimate (BE) 2026-27, Rs. 2,31,423.14 crore has been allocated to the Ministry of Rural Development (MoRD), of which Rs. 2,28,768.81 crore is for the Department of Rural Development. Allocation under BE is made against various programmes/schemes of the respective Departments but not State/UT-wise. Out of the allocation made for the programmes/ schemes under the budget estimate, funds are released to the States/Union Territories through respective
implementing mechanisms of the schemes, which includes submission of requisite documents / utilization certificate as per schematic requirements ensuring proper utilization of funds already allocated under the schemes, ensuring strict adherence of the schematic guidelines, assessing the actual requirement at the ground level and taking into account the balance of funds available with the States.

National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP) and the Digital India Land Records Modernization Programme (DILRMP) of MoRD are implemented in the UT of Delhi.

This information was given by the Minister of State for Rural Development SHRI KAMLESH PASWAN in a written reply in Lok Sabha today.
